title.narrative: DG ECHO PILOT PROGRAMMATIC PARTNERSHIP PROGRAMME (PPP)

description.narrative: Considering the prevailing humanitarian needs in Zambia, and the role and reach of the National Society, activities will be carried in three of the five pillars of the PPP: a) Disaster Risk Management, b) Cash and Voucher Assistance, c) Epidemic and Pandemic Preparedness and Response. In addition, the following PPP cross-cutting themes will be addressed: a) Anticipatory Action; b) Digital Transformation; c) Environmental Sustainability.

The action will focus on a holistic and multi-hazard/risk approach that will help to tackle national challenges while strengthening local capacities to anticipate for preparedness and response. The objectives will be achieved through the expansion of the coverage of people-based services, under protection and inclusion approaches and agile management mechanisms with transformative capabilities. To strengthen program management, staff & volunteers at national and branch Level will be trained in planning, monitoring, reporting, financial management and also in basic logistics.

The interventions will target 409,531 people in total in all the 3 pillars. It is estimated that the following number of beneficiaries will be reached through the 3 pillars with this Action, which is 40 percent of the total district population: Namwala District – 42,734, Mazabuka District – 203, 219, Monze District - 163, 578

ZRCS will target three districts in Southern Province of the country based on frequency and intensity of drought and floods in these districts and status of access to safe drinking water and sanitation facilities. According to the in-depth vulnerability assessment report of 2020, two of the targeted districts are hot spots for cholera outbreaks (Mazabuka and Monze) while Namwala district is prone to drought and floods.
